items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 83:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the MAN of Bina in the Nukva? When the Nukva ascends as MAN with ZA to Aba and Ima to receive the Mochin of the Nesira, and receives there the Mochin of the AB of the Mazal, which are the aspect of the male MAN, it is discerned that the Nukva serves with the MAN of the NHY of Bina, by her inclusion in her NHY. But the Nukva herself has no aspect of MAN there, because those MAN are from the first restriction, and the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction, which is the aspect of the MAN of the Nukva, is hidden in the unknown head (Reisha de-Lo Ityada), as above in Answer 7. But she serves there with a MAN that is not of her aspect, namely with the MAN of the Mazal, which is the MAN of the Ima of AB, as is known. (Item 138).
